research_role: article-level structured event extraction; no return forecast and no trading action
selection_basis: Operational correction after v3.8 full extraction failed at batch 313 because one item classified direct listed only NYDIG in affected_assets. V3.9 removes only the cross-field requirement coupling direct btc_relevance to a BTC or Bitcoin asset label. It retains the v3.8 closed alias allowlist, deterministic post-canonicalization dedupe preserving first occurrence, schema and value validation, evidence handling, model, prompt, sample, seed, batch size, and reliability thresholds. It does not consult or change market outcome, predictive metric, threshold, or trading result.

prior_operational_failure.reason: one direct item listed only NYDIG in affected_assets; the retained v3.5 cross-field requirement rejected the atomic four-record batch

btc_asset_alias_policy.duplicate_policy: after canonicalization, remove exact duplicate asset labels while preserving first occurrence order
btc_asset_alias_policy.unlisted_values: preserve then apply the unchanged v3.5 validator after dedupe
btc_asset_alias_policy.direct_btc_asset_coupling: disabled; btc_relevance and affected_assets remain independently validated fields

stage1_gate.decision: all requirements must pass before full-corpus extraction

stage2_only_if_stage1_passes.scope: one full extraction over 39393 articles from record 0; no outcome join, predictive test, threshold selection, backtest, or Tech overlay

prohibited: reusing the failed v3.8 checkpoint under the v3.9 contract
canonicalizing affected-assets values outside the frozen exact allowlist
changing btc_relevance or affected_assets values to manufacture cross-field consistency
changing prompt, schema, model digest, sample, batch size, or gate thresholds after Stage 1 begins
joining market outcomes before the full extraction artifact is complete and frozen
creating action, position size, or Tech overlay fields in the extractor
running more than one LLM worker
continuing compute at NVIDIA GPU temperature 75 C or above
